_metadata.description: Rules for inferring properties of unseen materials from known principles
_metadata.purpose: Enable LLM to generalize to materials not in the knowledge base

structure_type_inference.description: Rules for inferring crystal structure type from chemical formula

rules.pattern: Single element, Group 8-10 transition metals (Fe, Co, Ni, Ru, Rh, Pd, Os, Ir, Pt)
rules.inference: fcc or hcp, check periodic table position

rules.pattern: Single element, Group 4-6 transition metals (Ti, V, Cr, Zr, Nb, Mo, Hf, Ta, W)
rules.inference: bcc for most, hcp for Ti, Zr, Hf at room temperature

rules.pattern: Single element, Group 11 (Cu, Ag, Au) or Group 13 (Al)
MX formula with M=alkali/alkaline earth, X=halide
rules.inference: rocksalt (NaCl type) for similar ionic radii

rules.pattern: MO2 with M=Ce, Zr, Hf, Th

lattice_constant_estimation.description: Rules for estimating lattice constants from atomic/ionic radii

ionic.fluorite: a = 4 * r_cation / sqrt(3) (cation in center of anion cube)
ionic.perovskite: a = sqrt(2) * (r_A + r_O) or a = 2 * (r_B + r_O)

covalent.zincblende: a = 4 * d_bond / sqrt(3), where d_bond = r_A + r_B

lattice_constant_estimation.fallback: Use periodic trends: lattice constant generally increases down a group

property_interpolation.description: Interpolate properties between known similar materials

rules.method: Vegard's law: a_alloy = x * a_A + (1-x) * a_B
Linear interpolation based on atomic number

rules.condition: Same chemical family (e.g., all alkali halides)

defect_energy_estimation.description: Rules for estimating defect formation energies

vacancy_formation.ionic: Depends on charge state, typically 2-5 eV for cation vacancies
vacancy_formation.covalent: High due to dangling bonds, typically 3-4 eV for Si

substitution_favorability.size_rule: Hume-Rothery: < 15% size difference for significant solubility

chemical_similarity_groups.description: Groups of materials with similar properties for knowledge transfer

unknown_material: 2. Find most similar known material in same family
unknown_structure_type: 1. Check formula pattern against structure_type_inference rules
3. Apply radius ratio rules for ionic compounds
4. Default to most common structure type for that chemical family
